notes.title: New patch available
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24711616/e12ce50201d3d547dc9166db7afb776e86be104f.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone! First of all, thanks for your helpful feedback: we inform you that a new patch for Valentino Rossi The Game has just been released. Here's the changelog:

- Multiplayer stability fixes.
- Multiplayer Menu fixes.
- Localization fixes.

The game crashes that happened during some online multiplayer sessions have been fixed, as well as some malfunctions in the menu. Finally, we have corrected some in-game texts.

notes.title: New patch released: changelist inside
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!
We inform that a new patch for Valentino Rossi The Game has just been released on Steam. Here's the changelist:

- Fixed Riding Style customization in Multiplayer.
- Fixed Multiplayer qualifying logic.
- Fixed tyre selection in wet Multiplayer races.
- Fixed collisions for Phakisa and Aragon track.
- Tuned tyre wear for Multiplayer races.
- Various fixes.

A special thanks to all the guys who have reported the issues in the last few weeks.

notes.title: Quick update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,
we have just released a small fix that solves most of the issues that prevented some people to play online and to unlock new achievements. Achievements are now back. Concerning the online connection issues, here's a little guide to what changes after the patch:

- If you have never created a Milestone account or you are starting the game for the first time, just launch the game and play normally.
- If you have created a Milestone account through the Network section of the launcher and you logged in before, just launch the game and play normally
- If you have created a Milestone account and disconnected from the network section of the laucher OR formatted/reinstalled the game, you must log in using your credentials through the network section of the launcher. If you don't do so, your online progression will start from zero (basically, if you don't log in with your older account the game will automatically create another account)
- If you have lost your credentials, you can contact our customer support at http://www.milestone.it/supporto

notes.title: New patch available
notes.notes:
We announce that a new patch for Valentino Rossi The Game has just been released on Steam. Thank you so much for all the feedbacks you have sent us in these weeks. What follows is the changelist that comes with this new patch:

- Fixed a crash on Monza Rally Show.
- Fixed an audio issue on Split Screen mode.
- Fixed backfire effect of MotoGP™ bikes.
- Improved rider's animations on Flat Track races.
- Improved AI performance.
- Minor fixes on menu pictures.
- Minor bug fixes.
- Online functionalities completely migrated to Steam Infrastructure.

notes.title: New patch released!
notes.notes:
Dear riders,
a new patch for Valentino Rossi The Game has just been released. We've fixed most of the issues you've reported to our [url=www.milestone.it/supporto]Customer Support[/url] and we thank you for helping us making our game better. So, here you can read what has been changed:

[h1]Changelist[/h1]

[b]Bikes:[/b]
- The number on Rossi's Yamaha M1 2016 windshield has now a more realistic look
- The front wheel on Mahindra Moto3™ has been changed to match reality

[b]Graphics, sound and animations[/b]
- Sound quality of every bike has been improved
- Animations of riders falling off the bikes have been improved

[b]AI and difficulty balancing[/b]
- AI in R1M Mode on wet tracks has been improved to become more challenging
- AI performance has been improved in Moto3™, Moto2™ and MotoGP™ on many tracks
- Riders skills on Moto3™ roster have been balanced

[b]Bugs and crashes[/b]
- Solved a bug that caused audio effects to be disabled in Rally Mode
- All the cameras now show rain effects
- Leaderboards on Misano track in R1M Mode have been fixed
- Solved a bug that caused an invisible wall to appear in Aragon track
- Solved a bug that caused the game to crash during Rally Show in Career Mode
- Solved a bug that caused the game to crash during Rally Single Stage in Online mode
- Solved a bug that caused the game to crash during semaphore countdown in Online modes
- Solved a bug that caused the game to feeeze when pressing Pause in Online modes
- Victory conditions in events 5, 6, 8 and 9 in Real Events: 2015 MotoGP™ Season DLC have been fixed
- Solved a bug that caused autopilot not to work in Enduranch Mode when manual gear was active

[b]User interface improvements[/b]
- User interface showing scores in Drift Mode has been improved
- Now the user interface doesn't show riders names if the player chooses not to show them in the options menu
